name: Kastra Governance
description: Evaluates every tool call against your Kastra tenant policies — allow, block, or hold for human approval on the Kastra Edge desktop app.

deviceToken.label: Device token
deviceToken.help: Optional on machines with kastra-edge — defaults to device_handle from ~/.kastra/config.toml

holdMaxWaitMs.label: Max hold wait (ms)
holdMaxWaitMs.help: How long a hold may wait for approval before applying the rule's on-timeout decision. Clamped to 540000.

governMessages.label: Also govern outbound chat messages
governMessages.help: Adds a policy check to every channel reply (latency cost). Default off.
